216: Jake Blues, just released from prison, puts his old band back together to save the Catholic home where he and his brother Elwood were raised.
They'll never get caught. They're on a mission from God.
472: Against his father Odin's will, The Mighty Thor - a powerful but arrogant warrior god - recklessly reignites an ancient war. Thor is cast down to Earth and forced to live among humans as punishment. Once here, Thor learns what it takes to be a true hero when the most dangerous villain of his world sends the darkest forces of Asgard to invade Earth.

A world where heroes come in all sizes and adventure is the greatest magic of all.

A rags to riches to rags story.

In Montreal, Samuel L Jackson plays an appraiser going over its complex history.
1496: Barney Ross leads a band of highly skilled mercenaries including knife enthusiast Lee Christmas, a martial arts expert Yin Yang, heavy weapons specialist Hale Caesar, demolitionist Toll Road, and a loose-cannon sniper Gunner Jensen. 2008: Three backpackers head to a Slovakian city that promises to meet their hedonistic expectations, with no idea of the hell that awaits them.
2264: When an evil spirit known as Pitch lays down the gauntlet to take over the world, the immortal Guardians must join forces for the first time to protect the hopes, beliefs and imagination of children all over the world.

Once you see him, nothing can save you.
2776: When a group of rebellious deejays decides to defy the ban on government-censored music, they take to the seas to broadcast music and mayhem to millions of adoring fans.
On air. Off shore. Out of control.

Little People. Big Trouble. Lots of fun.
3544: Darius Stone's criminal record and extreme sports obsession make him the perfect candidate to be the newest XXX agent. He must save the U.S. government from a deadly conspiracy led by five-star general and Secretary of Defense George Deckert.

Say hola to his little friends.
4056: Lucía is a young waitress in Madrid who seeks refuge on a quiet, secluded Mediterranean island after the loss of her longtime boyfriend. Amidst the fresh air, dazzling sun, and glistening deep blue water, Lucía begins to piece together the dark corners of her past relationship.
4312: A fantasy movie about an arrogant, lazy prince and his more heroic brother who must complete a quest in order to save their father's kingdom.
4568: Clay is a young man in a small town who witnesses his friend, Earl, kill himself because of the ongoing affair that Clay was having with the man's wife, Amanda. Lester Long never forgets a friend.

Growing up isn't the problem... forgetting is.
5080: A French illusionist travels to Scotland to work. He meets a young woman in a small village. Their ensuing adventure in Edinburgh changes both their lives forever.
When life loses its wonder, all it takes is one person who still believes in magic.

Flunk 'em if they can't take a joke.

To avoid fainting keep repeating, it's only a movie... Only a movie... Only a movie...
Dr. John Collingwood (as Gaylord St. James)

The film that introduced Bossa Nova to the world...

So many women. So little time.

A younger man and a bolder woman

Six hundred feet beneath the surface terror runs deep

Hubert Bonisseur de La Bath, alias OSS 117
7128: A young woman fights the spirit that is slowly taking possession of her.
Evil will do anything to live.
7384: Jen's romantic getaway with her wealthy married boyfriend is disrupted when his friends arrive for an impromptu hunting trip. Tension mounts at the house until the situation culminates in an unexpected way.
Why do women always have to put up a fight?

Love is an act of defiance

In a world filled with violence... his only weapon is the truth!

8664: As an initiation rite into Alpha Sigma Rho fraternity, four pledges must spend a night in Garth Manor, twelve years to the day after the previous resident murdered his entire family.

What he wants is revenge. What he gets is the fight of his life.

2,000 colleges. 8 million roommates. Which one will you get?

No One Can Stand Its Mental Power!

10200: When Mahendra, the son of Bāhubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom.

11224: Fortune hunter Allan Quatermain teams up with a resourceful woman to help her find her missing husband lost in the wilds of 1900s Africa while being pursued by hostile tribes and a rival German explorer.
Khiva (as Kimursi of the Kipsigi Tribe)
Umbopa (as Siriaque of the Watussi Tribe)
Chief Gagool (as Sekaryongo of the Watussi Tribe)

Love is a force of nature
11992: After Ingrid leaves John, he allows himself to be pulled into a mystical and scary world where it is impossible to separate truth from lies.
Some doors should never be opened.

The world wanted to believe him. So did the camera.

Robert Klein, a successful art dealer who benefits from the misfortunes of those who are ruthlessly persecuted, discovers by chance that there is another Robert Klein, apparently a Jewish man; someone with whom he could be mistakenly identified, something dangerous in such harsh times.
In the nightmare labyrinth of the Occupation

13272: The Sorcerer and the White Snake is an ancient Chinese fable about a woman demon who falls in love with a mortal is brought to life through the latest advances in CGI and action techniques.

You'll meet some interesting people and hear some great songs at the Monster Club

...for the year's most outrageous romantic comedy.

14296: A mysterious warrior teams up with the daughter and son of a deposed Chinese Emperor to defeat their cruel brother, who seeks their deaths.
To save their souls they must save a kingdom.

Trapped underwater... with time running out.

The story that has never been told before

They came. They saw. They came.

A New Erotic Masterpiece from Tinto Brass, the Director of Caligula.

Winning is Just the Beginning Surviving is Another Story

The FBI thought they had him. It was the other way around.

All of the witnesses identify John Waldron, a nervous out-of-towner, as the killer. District Attorney Henry Harvey is then put on the case and faces political opposition in his attempt to prove Waldron's innocence.
It comes back at you again and again!
17624: Eight years after the opening night tragedy of HELL HOUSE LLC, many unanswered questions remain. Thanks to an anonymous tip, an investigative journalist is convinced that key evidence is hidden inside the abandoned Abaddon Hotel. She assembles a team to break into the hotel in hopes of discovering the truth. EIght years following the tragic events at the Abaddon Hotel, an investigation news team went searching for answers. The truth was more terrifying than they every imagined.
17880: A psychiatrist is drawn into a complex mind game when he questions a disturbed patient about the disappearance of a colleague.
18136: Remmy and her parents, refugees from Earth, have found peace on the Martian outskirts until strangers appear in the hills beyond their farm. Told as a triptych, the film follows Remmy as she struggles to survive in an uneasy landscape.
How far would you go to build a new life?

Fight for the light. Silence the darkness.
18904: A young drug dealer watches as his high-rolling life is dismantled in the wake of his cousin's murder, which sees his best friend arrested for the crime.
No one needs anything here. It's all about want.

But sometimes the ties that bind can cut off all circulation.
19928: Identical twin brothers become hybrid A.I (artificial intelligence) entities, yet torn in different directions to achieve justice for humanity.
20184: A harsh young man seduces a freeloading young woman and eventually takes advantage of her knack for hitchhiking to rob middle-class men.
20696: This film tells the story of a semi modern Iranian couple, who are trying to fight the old beliefs and old generation. This is a failing battle because the man is not strong enough.
20952: In order to see his little girl more often, a divorcee disguises himself as an old lady and gets a job as his own daughter's caretaker. A Hindi remake of the 1996 Tamil film "Avvai Shanmugi," which is itself a remake of the Hollywood film "Mrs. Doubtfire."

The Dead Rise When Daylight Ends
21464: Three fairy tale princesses find themselves engaged to the same guy, Prince Charming.
21720: Pandu is a contract killer and will accept any contract provided the amount is right. The police want him for questioning, while the underworld needs him to silence their opponents. No one really knows this assassin's background. It is only Pandu who knows his real identity, and he has no intention of sharing it with anyone.
21976: An eccentric multimillionaire signs an agreement to have his life ended. While selecting his coffin he meets a young woman who has signed up for the same arrangement. Trouble ensues when the couple falls in love and wishes to get out of the contract.

Three great stars in the story of love...coldly conceived from a man's need, and a woman's desire!

Tuura tries to get a signature to an important paper from a minister who's having a holiday in the area. Meanwhile, Uuno just relaxes and enjoys the sun.
22744: Sara is a teen girl who is looking forward to her 18th birthday to move away from her controlling father Don. But before she could even blow out the candles, Don imprisons her in the basement of their home.
23000: After reluctantly agreeing to coach cross-country, high school basketball Coach John Harrison helps the least likely runner attempt the impossible in the biggest race of the year.
What do you allow to define you?
23256: Ethan, a sullen high-school student whose life is defined by what he hates, finds love with a blindly optimistic Christian girl Trinity, much to the annoyance of his angst-filled band mates and her evangelistic brethren.
23512: Hapless family man Paul Matthews finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams. But when his nighttime appearances take a nightmarish turn, Paul is forced to navigate his newfound stardom.
Meet the man of your dreams.
23768: Over the course of ten days and 435 miles, an unbreakable bond is forged between pro adventure racer Michael Light and a scrappy street dog companion dubbed Arthur. As the team is pushed to their outer limits of endurance in the race, Arthur redefines what victory, loyalty and friendship truly mean.
An unexpected encounter. An unlikely bond. An unforgettable adventure.
24024: Housewives Alice and Celine are best friends and neighbours who seem to have it all. However, when a tragic accident shatters the harmony of their lives, guilt, suspicion and paranoia begin to unravel their sisterly bond.
Sometimes it's the only thing you can trust.
24280: After Ashley asks for a divorce, good-natured Carey runs to his friends, Julie and Paul, for support. He’s shocked to discover that the secret to their happiness is an open marriage, that is until Carey crosses the line and throws all of their relationships into chaos.
24536: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. 24792: Entrenched in a midlife crisis, Aziz seeks solace from his mundane job, lonesome friends and rowdy family while pretending to have his act together.
25048: In the first film, Enes Batur was shy and unable to relate to those around him, showing the audience how his life changed through his social media posts. In this sequel, he becomes a part of "Justice Warriors" and embarks upon an adventure which will eventually make him a superhero.
25304: An alcoholic barmaid is distraught when her former lover, a notorious gangster, re-enters her life. She is forced to relive painful past experiences and choose between the gangster and a pleasant singer she has found comfort in.
She fell in love with him the day she betrayed him...

Uncertain about his future, Jamie knows one thing for sure: he is going to be a sensation. Supported by his loving mom and his amazing friends, Jamie overcomes prejudice, beats the bullies and steps out of the darkness, into the spotlight.
The true story that became a musical sensation.
25816: Three young martial arts masters emerge from the back streets of Hong Kong to help the powerless fight injustice.
26328: Jeetendra Kumar Makwana is employed full-time at a Call Center and works part-time teaching English. He will soon find out that Bhaiyaji is a hoodlum and extortionist known to the Police as Lakhan Singh.
26584: When a handsome young Indian couple (Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor) moves into the suburbs to claim their stake in the American dream, they are shocked to discover that they've become enmeshed in a secretive terrorist plot. But as tensions escalate, the bride begins to wonder if her husband has told her everything he knows.
Some Love Stories  Have Blood On Them
26840: Soon after getting a new phone, a woman notices strange things starting to happen. When she investigates, she discovers that everyone who has had her phone number before her has died suddenly and mysteriously.
The Last Call You'll Ever Get...

Call Girl tells the story of how young Iris is recruited from the bottom of society into a ruthless world where power can get you anything.
Youth is seductive. Power is corrupt.
27352: Conditionally released four friends from jail must be away 100 meters from each other. but in the time they can not stay away each other, and come together for new adventure.

The day Lelouch vi Brittannia fell was the day this war-torn world found peace. Now, as his friends work to keep the peace, a terrorist attack could risk everything. Can the brilliant tactician outwit death and save them all? Or will Lelouch’s legacy fall here?
The power of the king will condemn you to solitude
27864: Four brothers try to find the mystery behind the murder of woman who raised them.
28120: The story of a man whose life was ruthlessly crippled by World War II. His wife and daughters were killed during the bombing of his village, he spent some time as a prisoner, and his only son was killed in action only a few days before the victory...
28376: A private boy's school opts to become mixed, and male students must adjust to the presence of new female students.

Those which change. Those which never change.  And those that don't want to change.
28888: When a city is overrun with a demonically-possessed crowd, a cop must find the source of evil to save his family.
The gates of hell have been opened.
29144: A brave young animal explorer teams up with two trusty friends to find a powerful artifact before his greedy uncle can get his paws on it.
Their differences will be their greatest strength!

Sam Baum is in love with his girlfriend who might still be in love with someone else.

Freedom is a state of mind.
29912: A researcher's family is kidnapped after she leads efforts to withdraw her company from a collaboration. With everything on the line, only her teenage daughter can save the family with help from a suicidal veteran and a prostitute.
Would you kill to live forever?
30168: In order to immortalize his love, a groom decides to create conflict between his and his to-be bride's families.

Whatever Happens, Don't Close Your Eyes

30936: Deep beneath the surface in the Syrian province of Ghouta, a group of female doctors have established an underground field hospital. Hope Shines in the Darkest Places

I know when the world will end.
31704: It is summertime in a blue-collar, marginal district of a city in the South of Spain. Tano, a teenager currently serving a sentence in a juvenile reform center, is given a 48-hour leave to attend his brother’s wedding.
32216: The funny clown Bratislav Metulskie is found dead in circus "Apollo". The retired commissioner 00 Schneider is asked to assume control of the case. Schneider and his aged sidekick Körschgen investigate to find the murderer.
